sources.title: A Multitask Deep Learning Model for Pediatric Echocardiography Analysis
sources.snippet: Congenital heart defects afflict ≈1% of all births worldwide. Although deep learning has shown significant promise in automating and improving adult echocardiography analysis, existing pediatric-based models are often limited to single tasks and specific echocardiographic views.
